world.title: Australia, Solomon Islands sign security pact in blow to China
world.summary: Australia and the Solomon Islands signed a security pact on Wednesday, designating Australia as the preferred defense partner for the Pacific nation. This agreement represents a significant shift, as the Solomon Islands had previously entered into a similar deal with China four years ago. The pact underscores Australia's growing influence in the region amid concerns over China's presence.

world.title: U.S. CIA, ODNI suffer cybersecurity breach of some unclassified information, NYT reports
world.summary: The U.S. Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI) reported a cybersecurity breach that exposed some unclassified information. The breach may have implications for other agencies, according to a report by the New York Times. The incident highlights ongoing vulnerabilities in government cybersecurity measures and the potential risks associated with unclassified data exposure.

world.title: US planning to hike tariffs against India, China and 14 other countries: Report
world.summary: The United States is set to increase tariffs on China, India, and 14 other countries, according to a Wall Street Journal report. The final tariff rates are not yet clear, but the new levies will likely be in addition to those resulting from a separate investigation into forced labor practices. The move aims to protect American industries.

business.title: Exclusive: Two Mistry letters to govt, 16 RBI meetings-inside the Tata Sons listing push
business.summary: An RTI investigation revealed that Shapoor Mistry sent two letters to the government regarding Tata Sons' listing. Additionally, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) rejected Tata Sons' application to surrender its core investment company registration on September 11. Since 2022, RBI officials and Tata leaders have conducted 16 meetings concerning this matter.

business.title: Stocks in news: Adani Enterprises, Tata Steel, PhysicsWallah, Hyundai Motor India, Lenskart and Hindalco
business.summary: Indian equity markets declined as benchmarks reversed early gains due to profit booking. The Nifty 50 index fell significantly, reflecting shifting investor sentiment. Companies like Adani Enterprises and Tata Steel announced developments impacting their stock performance. Additionally, Hyundai Motor India revealed a price increase across its vehicle range due to rising input costs, affecting various companies' future performance.

business.title: D-Street poised for a gap-up start as GIFT Nifty trades firmly higher
business.summary: Indian equities faced pressure from last week's global sell-off, particularly affecting the banking and commodities sectors. Despite potential spillover effects from international markets, experts believe the impact on India will be limited. Current support levels are at 25,000-25,100, with resistance at 25,500-25,600. Foreign portfolio investors have actively purchased equities worth Rs 5,672.

technology.title: Black Friday Streaming Discounts Offered By Disney+, HBO Max, Paramount+, Peacock & More
technology.summary: Major streaming services, including Disney+, HBO Max, Paramount+, and Peacock, are offering significant discounts for Black Friday. These promotions aim to attract bargain-hunters seeking streaming deals during the holiday shopping period. Disney+ and Hulu have introduced a bundle of their ad-supported tiers, enhancing the value for consumers looking to subscribe or upgrade their streaming options this season.

technology.title: GTA 6 available for cloud streaming on PS5 and PlayStation Portal
technology.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 is now available for cloud streaming on PlayStation 5 and PlayStation Portal for owners with a PlayStation Plus Premium subscription. Players can stream the game without needing to install it on their console. To access this feature, users must first purchase a copy of the game. This option enhances accessibility for gamers.

technology.title: GTA 6 Rakes In approximately $3.7 Billion on Launch Day; Hacked Leak Raises Specter of Unofficial PC Version
technology.summary: "Grand Theft Auto (GTA) 6" achieved a record-breaking launch, earning approximately $3.79 billion in retail sales on its first day, marking the largest opening day in entertainment history. However, shortly after its release, concerns arose regarding a potential unofficial PC version due to a hacked leak, raising questions about the game's security and distribution.

sports.title: Sooryavanshi, 15, blasts 204 off 53 balls for India A
sports.summary: Fifteen-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi scored an impressive 204 runs off just 53 balls, leading India A to a seven-wicket victory over the United Arab Emirates in the ACC Emerging Teams Asia Cup group-stage match held in Doha. His remarkable performance contributed significantly to the team's success, showcasing his talent on an international platform.

sports.title: Arsenal and Dortmund draw 1-1 as Gyokeres goes from hero to villain
sports.summary: Arsenal and Borussia Dortmund played to a 1-1 draw in the Champions League. Arsenal's Viktor Gyokeres scored a powerful goal but later missed a critical chance. Despite dominating possession and opportunities, Arsenal could not secure a win. The match highlighted Gyokeres' inconsistent performance, as he shifted from hero to villain during the game, according to manager Mikel Arteta.

sports.title: Immediate Reaction: Real Madrid 5-1 PSV Eindhoven
sports.summary: Real Madrid defeated PSV Eindhoven 5-1, with goals from Valverde, Bellingham, Mbappé (two goals), and Vinícius Júnior. The match showcased an impressive second-half performance by Real Madrid. Upcoming content will include player ratings, interviews, and a podcast discussing the game. This victory highlights Real Madrid's strong offensive capabilities in the current season.

health.title: Understanding Lung Cancer beyond smoking
health.summary: During Lung Cancer Awareness Month, Dr. Venkata Sampath V from Apollo Hospitals emphasizes that lung cancer risk factors extend beyond smoking. He references a 2024 Union Health Ministry response highlighting a medical review that identifies various contributors to the disease. Additionally, he addresses the emotional impact of social stigma associated with lung cancer, urging broader awareness and understanding.

health.title: Human Metabolic Chamber inaugurated at CMC in Vellore
health.summary: A Human Metabolic Chamber was inaugurated at Christian Medical College (CMC) in Vellore, developed through a collaboration between TIFR and CMC. This advanced facility allows for 24-hour research on metabolism, focusing on energy use and dietary impacts. The initiative aims to enhance understanding of nutrition, diabetes, obesity, and overall metabolic health, contributing to significant medical research advancements.

health.title: Siddhartha Yadav: New Class of Partially Functional BRCA2 Variants is Associated with Moderate Breast Cancer Risk
health.summary: Siddhartha Yadav, an Associate Professor at Mayo Clinic, announced a new study published in Nature Communications identifying partially functional BRCA2 variants linked to moderate breast cancer risk. This research highlights the significance of these hypomorphic variants in understanding breast cancer susceptibility, potentially influencing genetic counseling and risk assessment for individuals carrying these mutations. Further studies may be warranted.

science.title: A 13,000-year-old skeleton named Yotzin was discovered alongside mammoth fossils at an airport excavation site in Mexico; new research confirms it belonged to one of the earliest known human inhabitan
science.summary: A 13,000-year-old human skeleton, named Yotzin, was found during excavations near Mexico City, alongside mammoth fossils. Research confirms it as one of the earliest known human remains in the Basin of Mexico. This discovery provides valuable insights into early human habitation in the region, highlighting the significance of the site for understanding prehistoric life in the area.

science.title: Astronomers witness a rare cosmic event of a giant star swallowing a smaller one in the Andromeda Galaxy; 7 years of observations and data from the James Webb Telescope provide clues about these binar
science.summary: Astronomers have documented a rare event in the Andromeda Galaxy, where a giant star consumed its smaller companion. This stellar merger was observed over seven years using data from the James Webb Telescope. The process involves four stages: the formation of a dust shell, gradual brightening, an eruption on October 17, 2025, and subsequent dust expansion at the poles.

science.title: Scientists have predicted that lightning will strike much more often due to one reason
science.summary: Scientists from the Technical University of Munich predict that rising global temperatures will significantly increase thunderstorm activity, leading to more frequent lightning strikes. This forecast was published in the journal Earth's Future, highlighting the connection between climate change and extreme weather events. The research emphasizes the potential impacts of temperature increases on atmospheric conditions and storm frequency.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: November 25, 2026
entertainment.summary: On November 25, 2026, Aquarius may experience self-inflicted stress due to conflicting desires for change while maintaining current habits. This internal struggle is described as a choice made daily. The horoscope emphasizes the importance of recognizing this pattern and suggests that personal values, particularly regarding family, play a significant role in these decisions and feelings.

entertainment.title: Aquarius Horoscope Today: November 25, 2026
entertainment.summary: Aquarius individuals may experience frustration on November 25, 2026, stemming from a cycle of wanting change while maintaining current habits. This internal conflict is described as self-inflicted, suggesting that the choice to remain in familiar patterns is ongoing. The horoscope emphasizes the importance of recognizing this dynamic and encourages reflection on personal values and relationships to foster growth.

entertainment.title: Aries Horoscope Today: November 25, 2026
entertainment.summary: On November 25, 2026, Aries individuals are encouraged to break free from limiting habits and thought patterns. The horoscope suggests a readiness to leave behind anything that feels confining. As the firestarter of the zodiac, Aries is poised for transformation, signaling a time for renewal and liberation from past constraints, paving the way for new beginnings.
